theorems.name: Submission.lipschitz_range_piece_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (K : NNReal) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ), LipschitzWith K f → ∃ (Y : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (C : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))), (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) Y = 0 ∧ Set.range f ⊆ Y ∪ ⋃ i, f '' C i ∧ ∀ i, IsCompact (C i) ∧ (∀ w ∈ C i, DifferentiableAt ℝ f w ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f w)) ∧ ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) (C i) ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ C i, ∀ w ∈ C i, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖f v - f w‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
